description:
Delete the 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' artifact (and its version folder) from the 'example-repo-local' repository using the Artifactory web UI. CAUTION: Do NOT delete 'commons-io-2.15.1.jar' which is also in the repository. 

Starting state: Artifactory is open at http://localhost:8082. Login with admin/password. Navigate to the Artifacts browser, locate 'example-repo-local > org > apache > commons > commons-lang3 > 3.14.0', and delete it.
